definitions.explanation: A machine tool that rotates a workpiece on its axis to perform cutting, sanding, knurling, or other shaping operations.

notes:
A {旋盤|せんばん} is one of the most fundamental machine tools in metalworking and woodworking. The workpiece is clamped and rotated while a cutting tool is applied to shape it. The word comes from {旋|せん} (revolving) and ⟦{盤|ばん}→盤：18576_ban⟧ (platform, disc).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旋盤|せんばん}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧ — lathe machining
- {旋盤|せんばん}{工|こう} — lathe operator
- NC{旋盤|せんばん} — CNC lathe (computer-controlled)
- ⟦{汎用|はんよう}→汎用：07653_hanyou⟧{旋盤|せんばん} — general-purpose lathe
